+const isHexDigits = (value: string) => /^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(value);
+
+function HexColorField() {
+  const state = useContext(ColorPickerStateContext);
+  const currentDigits = state?.color.toString('hex').slice(1) ?? '';
+  const [digits, setDigits] = useState(currentDigits);
+  const [syncedDigits, setSyncedDigits] = useState(currentDigits);
+
+  // Pick up changes made outside this field, e.g. clicking a swatch
+  if (currentDigits !== syncedDigits) {
+    setSyncedDigits(currentDigits);
+    if (currentDigits.toLowerCase() !== digits.toLowerCase()) {
+      setDigits(currentDigits);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const onChangeValue = (value: string) => {
+    const nextDigits = value.replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, '').slice(0, 6);
+    setDigits(nextDigits);
+
+    if (isHexDigits(nextDigits)) {
+      const color = parseColor(`#${nextDigits}`);
+      if (color) {
+        state?.setColor(color);
+      }
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
+      <View style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
+        <span
+          aria-hidden="true"
+          style={{
+            position: 'absolute',
+            left: 6,
+            top: '50%',
+            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
+            color: theme.formInputTextPlaceholder,
+            pointerEvents: 'none',
+          }}
+        >
+          #
+        </span>
+        <Input
+          aria-label="Hex color"
+          placeholder="RRGGBB"
+          value={digits}
+          onChangeValue={onChangeValue}
+          onBlur={() => setDigits(currentDigits)}
+          style={{ width: 100, paddingLeft: 16 }}
+        />
+      </View>
+      <ColorPreview color={isHexDigits(digits) ? `#${digits}` : null} />
+    </View>
+  );
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+
+import { Button } from './Button';
+import { ColorPicker } from './ColorPicker';
+
+function renderOpenPicker(defaultValue = '#690CB0') {
+  const onChange = vi.fn();
+  render(
+    <ColorPicker defaultValue={defaultValue} onChange={onChange}>
+      <Button>Pick a color</Button>
+    </ColorPicker>,
+  );
+  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pick a color' }));
+
+  return {
+    onChange,
+    input: screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Hex color' }),
+    preview: () => screen.getByTestId('color-preview'),
+  };
+}
+
+describe('ColorPicker', () => {
+  it('shows the current color without "#" in the editable text', () => {
+    const { input, preview } = renderOpenPicker('#690CB0');
+
+    expect(input).toHaveProperty('value', '690CB0');
+    expect(screen.getByText('#')).toBeTruthy();
+    expect(preview().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Color preview: #690CB0');
+  });
+
+  it('updates the color while typing, without needing "#"', () => {
+    const { input, onChange, preview } = renderOpenPicker();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'FF0000' } });
+
+    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(onChange.mock.calls[0][0].toString('hex')).toBe('#FF0000');
+    expect(preview().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Color preview: #FF0000');
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the "#" prefix when all text is deleted', () => {
+    const { input, onChange, preview } = renderOpenPicker();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '' } });
+
+    expect(input).toHaveProperty('value', '');
+    expect(screen.getByText('#')).toBeTruthy();
+    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(preview().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('No color preview');
+  });
+
+  it('strips "#" and invalid characters from pasted values', () => {
+    const { input, onChange } = renderOpenPicker();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '#00ff00zz' } });
+
+    expect(input).toHaveProperty('value', '00ff00');
+    expect(onChange.mock.calls[0][0].toString('hex')).toBe('#00FF00');
+  });
+
+  it('reverts an incomplete value on blur', () => {
+    const { input, onChange, preview } = renderOpenPicker('#690CB0');
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'FF0' } });
+    expect(preview().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('No color preview');
+
+    fireEvent.blur(input);
+
+    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(input).toHaveProperty('value', '690CB0');
+  });
+
+  it('syncs the text and preview when a swatch is picked', () => {
+    const { input, preview } = renderOpenPicker('#690CB0');
+
+    const swatch = screen
+      .getAllByRole('option')
+      .find(option => option.dataset.key?.startsWith('#D32F2F'));
+    if (!swatch) {
+      throw new Error('Swatch #D32F2F not found');
+    }
+    fireEvent.click(swatch);
+
+    expect(input).toHaveProperty('value', 'D32F2F');
+    expect(preview().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Color preview: #D32F2F');
+  });
+});

+import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
+
+import { View } from './View';
+
+const EMPTY_PATTERN =
+  'repeating-conic-gradient(#d9d9d9 0% 25%, #ffffff 0% 50%) 50% / 8px 8px';
+
+type ColorPreviewProps = {
+  color: string | null;
+  style?: CSSProperties;
+};
+
+export function ColorPreview({ color, style }: ColorPreviewProps) {
+  return (
+    <View
+      role="img"
+      aria-label={color ? `Color preview: ${color}` : 'No color preview'}
+      data-testid="color-preview"
+      style={{
+        width: 32,
+        height: 32,
+        flexShrink: 0,
+        borderRadius: 4,
+        boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)',
+        background: color ?? EMPTY_PATTERN,
+        ...style,
+      }}
+    />
+  );
+}

  '#D4B89C', //brown
  '#BFBFBF', //gray
  '#FFAEAE', //colors repeat from above with a lighter tint
  '#FFCCFF',
  '#E4D4FF', //this is now purple125
  '#B0B0FF',
  '#D8FFFF',
  '#CFE5CF',
  '#FFFFB2',
  '#FFD5B3',
  '#E4D3C3',
  '#DADADA',
];

type ColorSwatchPickerProps = {
  columns?: number;
  colorset?: string[];
};

function ColorSwatchPicker({
  columns = 5,
  colorset = DEFAULT_COLOR_SET,
}: ColorSwatchPickerProps) {
  const pickers = [];

  for (let l = 0; l < colorset.length / columns; l++) {
    const pickerItems = [];

    for (let c = 0; c < columns; c++) {
      const color = colorset[columns * l + c];
      if (!color) {
        break;
      }

      pickerItems.push(
        <ColorSwatchPickerItem
          key={color}
          color={color}
          className={css({
            position: 'relative',
            outline: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            width: 'fit-content',
            forcedColorAdjust: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',

            '&[data-selected]::after': {
              content: '""',
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              border: '2px solid black',
              outline: '2px solid white',
              outlineOffset: '-4px',
              borderRadius: 'inherit',
            },
          })}
        >
          <ColorSwatch />
        </ColorSwatchPickerItem>,
      );
    }

    pickers.push(
      <AriaColorSwatchPicker
        key={`colorset-${l}`}
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '8px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
        }}
      >
        {pickerItems}
      </AriaColorSwatchPicker>,
    );
  }

  return pickers;
}
const isHexDigits = (value: string) => /^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(value);

function HexColorField() {
  const state = useContext(ColorPickerStateContext);
  const currentDigits = state?.color.toString('hex').slice(1) ?? '';
  const [digits, setDigits] = useState(currentDigits);
  const [syncedDigits, setSyncedDigits] = useState(currentDigits);

  // Pick up changes made outside this field, e.g. clicking a swatch
  if (currentDigits !== syncedDigits) {
    setSyncedDigits(currentDigits);
    if (currentDigits.toLowerCase() !== digits.toLowerCase()) {
      setDigits(currentDigits);
    }
  }

  const onChangeValue = (value: string) => {
    const nextDigits = value.replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, '').slice(0, 6);
    setDigits(nextDigits);

    if (isHexDigits(nextDigits)) {
      const color = parseColor(`#${nextDigits}`);
      if (color) {
        state?.setColor(color);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
      <View style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: 6,
            top: '50%',
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            color: theme.formInputTextPlaceholder,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
          }}
        >
          #
        </span>
        <Input
          aria-label="Hex color"
          placeholder="RRGGBB"
          value={digits}
          onChangeValue={onChangeValue}
          onBlur={() => setDigits(currentDigits)}
          style={{ width: 100, paddingLeft: 16 }}
        />
      </View>
      <ColorPreview color={isHexDigits(digits) ? `#${digits}` : null} />
    </View>
  );
}

type ColorPickerProps = {
  children?: ReactNode;
  columns?: number;
  colorset?: string[];
} & AriaColorPickerProps;

export function ColorPicker({
  children,
  columns,
  colorset,
  ...props
}: ColorPickerProps) {
  return (
    <AriaColorPicker defaultValue={props.defaultValue ?? '#690CB0'} {...props}>
      <DialogTrigger>
        {children}
        <Popover>
          <Dialog
            style={{
              outline: 'none',
              padding: '15px',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: '8px',
              minWidth: '192px',
              maxHeight: 'inherit',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              overflow: 'auto',
            }}
          >
            <ColorSwatchPicker columns={columns} colorset={colorset} />
            <HexColorField />
          </Dialog>
        </Popover>
      </DialogTrigger>
    </AriaColorPicker>
  );
}

It also adds a ColorPreview swatch next to the input that shows the typed color (or an empty pattern for incomplete values), kept in sync with swatch selection via ColorPickerStateContext.\nThis change was needed in order to provide the user a clearer view of the custom color they type in.\n\n<!-- If AI tools wrote a significant part of this change, please disclose it here and name the tool you used. Chose to have a fixed \"#\" prefix, where the input only holds 6 digits|\n| Alternatives Considered | Keeping \"#\" in the value and block deleting it| \n| Rationale | Drawing a \"#\" inside the input border and having the input hold only the digits is a lot easier and less risky than intercepting any kind of Backspace/Delete when the cursor is at position 1 because there are a lot of easy-to-miss cases | \n| Consequences | Needed a swatch sync via `ColorPickerStateContext`; the other option had smaller potential diff, but would've been more fragile | \n\n\n## Tech Debt\n**Introduced:**  I replaced react-aria's ColorField with a custom input so the \"#\" can't be deleted, which means 3-digit shorthand (F00) and the built-in color-field accessibility behavior are gone. {"body":"## Summary\n\nThe tag color editor is not ideal from a UX perspective, especially when adding a custom HEX color. Firstly if the user removes the \"#\" from the beginning of the beginning of their custom color, they cannot see the tag color dynamically change until they close the menu. This \"#\" should not be able to be deleted, or should continue to dynamically update the tag color when not present. \n\nAdditionally, sometimes when editing a custom HEX color it is hard to see the color the tag is changing to. Thus, a custom color field should appear to the right of the HEX color text input, dynamically showing the color of the custom color, so the user can easily see what color they are about to change their tag to without relying on looking at the small changes to the tag in the UI.\n\n## User Story\n\nAs a user who wants to customize my tag colors for transactions, I have trouble seeing the HEX codes I type in dynamically update the tag, and would like to see a clean preview in the color editor for clarity.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n\n1. The tag color editor now either should not allow for the \"#\" to be deleted in the text field, or should continue to dynamically update tag color without the \"#\" if the user chooses to delete it.\n2. The tag color editor displays a dynamic preview of the user's custom color in a small box adjacent to the custom color text field.\n3. No tag coloring logic is broken.\n\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- A custom color editor\n- Changes to the overall UI or structure of the color picker\n- Changes to any tag logic\n\n## Open Questions\n\n1. What should the size of the color preview be, rectangle or square?\n2. Should the program not allow for the \"#\" to be deleted in the custom color text field?\n3. Does this tag color picker appear elsewhere outside of editing tag colors?\n\n\n## Rough Scope\n\nMedium — A new UI component will need to be created to dynamically render custom colors and some changes to the text field component will be needed. No backend changes are needed, and most color logic already exists. The code owner will have to decide how to handle the \"#\" issue.\n\n## Source\n\nPersonal frustrations with the app.","title":"Custom Color Improvements For Tag Color Editor"}

import type { RefObject } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@actual-app/components/button';
import { ColorPicker } from '@actual-app/components/color-picker';
import type { TagEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import { useTagCSS } from '#hooks/useTagCSS';
import { useUpdateTagMutation } from '#tags';

type TagEditorProps = {
  tag: TagEntity;
  ref: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
};

export const TagEditor = ({ tag, ref }: TagEditorProps) => {
  const getTagCSS = useTagCSS({ ellipsis: true });
  const { mutate: updateTag } = useUpdateTagMutation();

  const formattedTag = <>#{tag.tag}</>;

  return (
    <ColorPicker
      value={tag.color ?? undefined}
      onChange={color => {
        updateTag({ tag: { ...tag, color: color.toString('hex') } });
      }}
    >
      <Button variant="bare" className={getTagCSS(tag.tag)} ref={ref}>
        {formattedTag}
      </Button>
    </ColorPicker>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import type {
  ChangeEvent,
  ComponentPropsWithRef,
  FocusEvent,
  KeyboardEvent,
} from 'react';
import { Input as ReactAriaInput } from 'react-aria-components';

import { css, cx } from '@emotion/css';

import { useResponsive } from './hooks/useResponsive';
import { styles } from './styles';
import { theme } from './theme';

export const baseInputStyle = {
  outline: 0,
  backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
  color: theme.formInputText,
  margin: 0,
  padding: 5,
  borderRadius: 4,
  border: '1px solid ' + theme.formInputBorder,
};

export const defaultInputClassName = css({
  ...baseInputStyle,
  color: theme.formInputText,
  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
  overflow: 'hidden',
  flexShrink: 0,
  '&[data-focused]': {
    border: '1px solid ' + theme.formInputBorderSelected,
    boxShadow: '0 1px 1px ' + theme.formInputShadowSelected,
  },
  '&[data-disabled]': {
    color: theme.formInputTextPlaceholder,
  },
  '::placeholder': { color: theme.formInputTextPlaceholder },
  ...styles.smallText,
});

export type InputProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<typeof ReactAriaInput> & {
  onEnter?: (value: string, event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  onEscape?: (value: string, event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  onChangeValue?: (
    newValue: string,
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
  ) => void;
  onUpdate?: (newValue: string, event: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
};

export function Input({
  ref,
  onEnter,
  onEscape,
  onChangeValue,
  onUpdate,
  className,
  ...props
}: InputProps) {
  return (
    <ReactAriaInput
      ref={ref}
      className={
        typeof className === 'function'
          ? renderProps => cx(defaultInputClassName, className(renderProps))
          : cx(defaultInputClassName, className)
      }
      {...props}
      onKeyUp={e => {
        props.onKeyUp?.(e);

        if (e.key === 'Enter' && onEnter) {
          onEnter(e.currentTarget.value, e);
        }

        if (e.key === 'Escape' && onEscape) {
          onEscape(e.currentTarget.value, e);
        }

export function useUpdateTagMutation() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ tag }: UpdateTagPayload) => {
      return await send('tags-update', tag);
    },
    onSuccess: () => invalidateQueries(queryClient),
    onError: error => {
      console.error('Error updating tag:', error);
      dispatchErrorNotification(
        dispatch,
        t('There was an error updating the tag. Please try again.'),
        error,
      );
    },
  });
}

# Review: PR #136, "[AI] Add live hex color preview and fixed "#" to tag color picker"

**Verdict:** I agree it's good. I'd merge it. Nothing I found blocks it, and the few follow-ups below are small.

**What I checked:**
- **Scope:** the PR changes only 5 files.
- **Tests:** I ran the component-library tests locally and all 25 passed, including the 6 new ones.
- **Lint and format:** the repo's own oxlint and oxfmt pass on the changed files.
- **CI:** every check on the PR is green (lint, typecheck, knip, unit tests, end-to-end and screenshot tests).
- **Callers:** I read both places that use the picker, `TagEditor.tsx` and `TagCreationRow.tsx`.

## Scorecard

| Criterion | Score (1–10) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Correctness — does the change do what the issue asked? | **8** | Meets all three acceptance criteria in #66. **AC1:** the "#" is drawn outside the input, so it can't be deleted, and typing without "#" still updates the color live. **AC2:** a preview square sits next to the field and updates as you type. **AC3:** no tag logic changed; it still uses the same `onChange` → `updateTag` path. One small edge case with a slow save, explained below. |
| Test coverage — are tests present and meaningful? | **7** | Six focused tests cover the AC behaviors: typing, clearing the field, pasting, reverting on blur, and syncing with a swatch click. **Gap:** every test passes `defaultValue`, so the picker manages its own color. Both real callers instead pass `value` and get the new color back asynchronously, which is the path where the edge case lives. The tests also use `fireEvent.change` instead of real keystrokes (`userEvent`), so cursor behavior isn't tested. No end-to-end or screenshot test covers the popover; the PR admits this. |
| Code quality — consistent style, clear naming, no unnecessary duplication | **8** | Small and readable. `HexColorField` is a sensible private helper, and the render-time sync is a valid React pattern with a comment explaining it. Minor nits are listed below: dead code, duplicated swatch styles, a checkerboard that ignores dark mode, and the "#" font size not tied to the input's. |
| Documentation — inline comments and PR description are clear | **9** | Excellent PR description: the Design table explains *why* "#" sits outside the input rather than blocking Backspace, and the Tech Debt section honestly lists what was lost. The release note follows the repo conventions. The inline comment on the sync block is enough. |
| AI transparency — if AI was used, is there evidence of human verification? | **7** | Good signals: the `[AI]` commit and title prefix, the `Co-Authored-By` line, the disclosure in the PR body, a self-review checkbox ("I have read every line…"), manual-testing steps on the Tags page, and candid tech-debt notes. **Missing:** I found no AI log for this work in `ai-logs/sprint2/icsasso/` on this branch. Check whether it went up in a separate PR, the way yours did for #115. A screenshot of the hand testing would make the verification claim more convincing. |
| **Overall — would you merge this as-is?** | **8** | **Yes.** Nothing blocks it. If the author has time, the edge case and the controlled-mode test are worth a small follow-up. |

## Details

### 1. Typing can be undone while a tag save is in flight (minor)
[ColorPicker.tsx:155-161](packages/component-library/src/ColorPicker.tsx#L155-L161)

`TagEditor` passes `value={tag.color}`. `useUpdateTagMutation` doesn't update the cached tag right away. It sends the change to the backend and refreshes the tag list when the save succeeds, so the new color reaches the picker a moment later.

**Sequence:**
1. The user finishes typing `FF0000`, which calls `setColor` and starts the save.
2. They immediately press Backspace to fix a typo, leaving `FF000`.
3. The refreshed `tag.color` arrives. The sync block sees `currentDigits` change and replaces the user's `FF000` with `FF0000`.

The window is small because everything is local, which is why I don't consider it blocking. A cheap fix is to skip the external sync while the input has focus, since a swatch click blurs the input anyway.

A related cosmetic effect: blurring before the save finishes briefly shows the old color.

`TagCreationRow` keeps its color in local state, so it isn't affected.

### 2. Tests don't cover how the real callers use the picker
Add one test that renders `<ColorPicker value={…} onChange={…}>` with a parent that applies the change, ideally after a delay. That's how both callers in the app use it.

The swatch lookup `option.dataset.key?.startsWith('#D32F2F')` depends on react-aria internals and may break when react-aria is upgraded. Finding the option by its accessible name would be sturdier.

### 3. Small code nits (all optional)
- **Dead check:** `if (color)` after `parseColor` can never be false. `parseColor` throws on bad input instead of returning null, and the regex already guarantees valid input. It was carried over from the old code.
- **Duplicated styles:** `ColorPreview` repeats `ColorSwatch`'s size, corner radius and inset shadow (32px, 4px). Shared constants would keep the two squares matching if one changes.
- **Dark mode:** `EMPTY_PATTERN` hard-codes `#d9d9d9` and `#ffffff`, so the empty checkerboard will look bright in dark themes. The PR acknowledges this.
- **"#" alignment:** the "#" `<span>` doesn't set a font size, but `Input` uses `styles.smallText` (`--font-size-13`). With a different font-size setting, the "#" could drift relative to the `paddingLeft: 16` gap. Adding `...styles.smallText` to the span would tie them together.
- **Test hook in shipped code:** `data-testid="color-preview"` ships in a library component. The tests could find the preview by its `role="img"` and label instead.
- **Cursor jump (unverified):** typing a stripped character like `#` in the middle of the text may move the cursor to the end, because the input is controlled and its value doesn't change. It's worth a quick manual check.

### 4. Things that looked suspicious but are fine
- **Bundle stats:** the bot comment shows `index.js` growing by 766 kB and several chunks removed. That comes from the PR's base being out of date, not from this PR. The only change attributable to it is `ColorPicker.tsx` (+2.17 kB) and `ColorPreview.tsx` (+905 B).
- **Untranslated labels:** "Hex color" and "Color preview" aren't translated. That's accurate to the PR's tech-debt note, since component-library has no i18n, and the repo's lint passes. If you want them translated later, have the picker take the labels as optional props and pass translated strings from desktop-client.
